scope: Accepted additive Help reader data model; no publisher, grant or runtime activation

constraints.definition: CHECK (((publication_state <> 'published'::text) OR ((tenant_id IS NOT NULL) AND (locale IS NOT NULL) AND (published_at IS NOT NULL) AND (published_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,199}$'::text) AND pc10_help_v1_valid_text(question, 1, 500) AND pc10_help_v1_valid_text(answer, 1, 5000) AND pc10_help_v1_valid_text(category, 1, 100) AND pc10_help_v1_valid_text(summary, 0, 1000))))
